comments.author: WW
comments.body:
Mine didn't repair my equipped gear. I was sailing with no disaster. It was raining though.

Does it not give the effect every time or did I do something wrong?

comments.author: Wystein
comments.body:
World (and Empress) tarot card repair effects will not work if you have a status effect currently happening. In addition to the various disaster effects this also includes beneficial effects like dolphins and seagulls. In my experience the most common reason the effect does not work is seagulls as they can be difficult to notice.

If there is no other effect and your at sea the effect always works. Note that you don't need to be moving so if possible when it is about to expire I sit right outside a port/landing zone so if a seagull or other effect happens I can port quickly to get rid of it.
